title: Bonds to Increase Safety, Security; Repair, Construct Schools; Increase Accessibility
ballot_label: Caption: Bonds to Increase Safety, Security; Repair, Construct Schools; Increase Accessibility. Question: Shall District issue bonds, projected to maintain 2026 bond rate, to increase safety, repair, replace aging schools and increase accessibility? If the bonds are approved, they will be payable from taxes on property or property ownership that are not subject to the limits of sections 11 and 11b, Article XI of the Oregon Constitution.
summary: Reynolds School District No. 7 asks to issue $162.5 million in general obligation bonds for capital projects: replacing Glenfair Elementary; districtwide roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical and water heater work; fire alarm, PA and perimeter security systems; ADA upgrades; and other projects including a turf field at Reynolds High School. A community oversight committee and regular audits would be required.
yes_means: A yes vote authorizes Reynolds School District to issue $162.5 million in bonds, repaid from property taxes, for safety, security, school repair and replacement, and accessibility projects.
no_means: A no vote does not authorize the district to issue the proposed bonds.
fiscal_impact: Principal of $162.5 million. Projected to maintain the district's 2026 bond levy rate of $1.62 per $1,000 of assessed value, with no increase expected. If passed, the district would receive $8,168,000 in state matching funds through the Oregon School Capital Improvement Match Program.
